findings.one_line: The finite-breakout quotient is a substantive ExactID result, but the advertised iff 'frontier' is positioned too strongly: its no-breakout half is obtained on the purpose-defined branch ℕ_ρ that already requires a legal source-swapped partner; state this as a conditional boundary result and distinguish it from a characterization of all no-breakout laws in the ambient/population class.

Positioning is not yet sufficient for the headline theorem: add theorem-level comparisons and a relevance sentence for every bibliography entry currently omitted from the substantive review (notably Causal Dantzig, Wang et al., Li et al., and Davis--Kahan), and reconcile the all-'unmatched' comparator table with the claimed closest-result distinctions.
